name: livestock_generate_otp
description: Sends OTP to the Aadhaar-linked mobile number for livestock vaccination service authentication. Does NOT verify the OTP or create a session. Fails if Aadhaar is invalid or mobile number is not registered.

name: livestock_verify_otp
description: Verifies the OTP and returns a session_token for livestock vaccination operations. Does NOT register animals or book vaccinations. Fails if OTP is expired, incorrect, or not generated.

name: livestock_register_animal
description: Registers a new animal in the livestock registry linked to the farmer's profile. Transitions livestock_status to 'registered'. Each animal gets a unique livestock_id. Requires session_token. Does NOT book vaccinations or verify health status. Fails if duplicate animal details exist, animal_type is unsupported, or farmer is not authenticated.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

age_months.description: Age of the animal in months.

tag_number.description: Ear tag or identification number if available. Optional.

name: livestock_get_vaccination_schedule
description: Retrieves the vaccination schedule for a registered animal based on species, age, and disease type. Schedule includes vaccine name, due date, and type (routine/emergency/booster). Requires session_token. Livestock must be registered. Does NOT book vaccinations. Fails if livestock_id is invalid, animal is not registered, or species has no applicable schedule.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

livestock_id.description: Unique identifier for a registered animal.

disease_type.description: Disease filter. Allowed: 'fmd', 'brucellosis', 'ppr', 'rabies', 'anthrax'. Optional — returns all if omitted.

name: livestock_book_vaccination
description: Books a vaccination service for a registered animal. Transitions vaccination_status to 'scheduled'. Animal must be registered and eligible based on age and schedule. Requires session_token. Does NOT administer the vaccine or assign field workers — use livestock_track_service. Fails if livestock is not registered, vaccination is outside schedule window, duplicate booking exists, or animal_type-disease mismatch.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

livestock_id.description: Unique identifier for a registered animal.

name: livestock_track_service
description: Tracks the service request status for a booked vaccination. Returns service_status ('not_requested', 'requested', 'assigned', 'completed', 'failed') with assigned field worker details. Requires session_token. Does NOT administer vaccines. Fails if booking_id is invalid or no service request exists.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

booking_id.description: Unique identifier of the vaccination booking.

name: livestock_record_vaccination
description: Records that a vaccination has been administered by authorized personnel. Transitions vaccination_status to 'administered'. Vaccination must be in 'scheduled' status and service must be 'assigned' or 'completed'. Requires session_token. Farmers CANNOT self-administer via this system. Does NOT generate certificates. Fails if vaccination is not scheduled, unauthorized personnel attempt recording, or duplicate record exists.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

livestock_id.description: Unique identifier for a registered animal.

vaccine_batch_number.description: Batch number of the vaccine administered.

name: livestock_get_vaccination_history
description: Retrieves complete vaccination history for a registered animal including all past vaccinations, dates, and vaccines used. Requires session_token. Does NOT book new vaccinations. Fails if livestock_id is invalid or no history exists.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

livestock_id.description: Unique identifier for a registered animal.

name: livestock_reschedule_vaccination
description: Reschedules a missed or upcoming vaccination to a new date. Transitions vaccination_status to 'rescheduled'. Vaccination must be in 'scheduled' or 'missed' status. Requires session_token. Does NOT administer vaccines. Fails if vaccination is already administered, booking_id is invalid, or new date conflicts with schedule.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: livestock_track_vaccination_status
description: Returns the current vaccination_status ('not_scheduled', 'scheduled', 'administered', 'missed', 'rescheduled') for a specific booking. Requires session_token. Does NOT modify status. Fails if booking_id is invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: livestock_get_disease_advisory
description: Provides disease-specific advisory for livestock including symptoms, prevention, and vaccination importance. Requires session_token. Does NOT book vaccinations or diagnose animals. Advisory is informational only. Fails if disease_type is unsupported or animal_type has no applicable advisory.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: livestock_check_schedule_validity
description: Checks whether a vaccination request is valid based on the animal's age, species, and last vaccination date. Returns validity status and reason. Requires session_token. Does NOT book vaccinations. Fails if livestock_id is invalid or vaccination records are incomplete.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

livestock_id.description: Unique identifier for a registered animal.

name: livestock_get_nearest_veterinary_service
description: Returns nearby veterinary service centres and field workers available for vaccination. Requires session_token. Does NOT book services. Availability may vary. Fails if location is invalid or no services found in the area.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: livestock_cancel_service
description: Cancels a booked vaccination service. Only possible when service_status is 'requested' or 'assigned' (before administration). Requires session_token. Does NOT refund or modify records. Fails if service is already completed or vaccination administered.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: livestock_raise_grievance
description: Raises a grievance about livestock vaccination services. Valid categories: 'service_delay', 'vaccination_not_done', 'incorrect_record', 'schedule_issue', 'field_worker_issue'. Must check service/vaccination status first. Requires session_token. Does NOT resolve grievances. Fails if category is invalid or duplicate exists.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: livestock_track_grievance_status
description: Tracks a previously raised grievance. Returns resolution status and remarks. Requires session_token. Does NOT raise new grievances. Fails if grievance_id is invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.
